findings.finding: Webhook verification uses raw request bytes, signed timestamp, constant-time comparison, replay deduplication, and a bounded dual-secret rotation window.
evidence: modified body and invalid signature rejected
timestamp older than freshness window rejected
second delivery of the same authenticated event produced no duplicate protected effect
current and previous signing secrets accepted during bounded rotation overlap
findings.recommendation: Keep negative, replay, and rotation tests in the release gate.

remaining_risks: Re-verify the signing contract when the provider changes signature versions, canonicalization, or header semantics.
